commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Said Martinez blows his whistle and it's Morgan Rogers (England) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+6' Declan Rice (England) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90+5' The substitution has been made. Abdul Baba (Ghana) has replaced Prince Adu.
90+5' Eberechi Eze (England) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. England have a corner.
90+4' Declan Rice (England) launches a cross from the corner, but Benjamin Asare is alert to thwart the effort.
90+3' Marc Guehi (England) produces a clever header from around the penalty spot, but it's stopped by one of the defending players. England have been awarded a corner kick.
90+3' The ball goes behind for a corner. England will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Marcus Rashford (England) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
90+2' Declan Rice (England) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ghana.
90+1' A lofted cross from Declan Rice (England) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. England force their opponents to concede a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Antoine Semenyo (Ghana) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
89' Marcus Rashford (England) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Said Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.
87' Carlos Queiroz has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kojo Peprah (Ghana) replacing Marvin Senaya.
86' Harry Kane (England) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
86' Nico O'Reilly (England) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
86' Bukayo Saka (England) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
85' Referee Said Martinez sees the trip by Marcus Rashford (England) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
84' Said Martinez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Caleb Yirenkyi (Ghana) and blew his whistle.
83' Noni Madueke comes off the pitch to be replaced by Marcus Rashford (England).
83' The free kick is taken by Bukayo Saka (England), but ball is cleared.
82' Gideon Mensah (Ghana) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. England have been awarded a free kick.
81' The game is interrupted as Bukayo Saka (England) is flagged offside.
79' Antoine Semenyo (Ghana) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
77' Harry Kane (England) commits a rough challenge and Said Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Declan Rice (England) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
75' Morgan Rogers (England) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to England.
74' Substitution. Eberechi Eze (England) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Elliot Anderson walks off.
73' Here is a change. Jude Bellingham is going off and Thomas Tuchel gives the last tactical orders to Morgan Rogers (England).
71' A cooling break is underway.
70' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Bukayo Saka (England) who loops his header high over the bar.
70' The attendance for today's match is 63983.

69' Harry Kane (England) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom right corner. Benjamin Asare has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
67' Prince Adu (Ghana) is penalised for a foul. Said Martinez had a clear view and blows his whistle.
67' Today's match ends for Jordan Ayew who will be replaced by Prince Adu (Ghana).
66' Substitution. Inaki Williams did his best and is replaced by Issahaku Fatawu (Ghana).
66' Thomas Tuchel decides to make a substitution. Djed Spence will be replaced by Nico O'Reilly (England).
65' Substitution. Bukayo Saka (England) replaces Anthony Gordon.
64' My Gran could have done better! Noni Madueke (England) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
64' Elliot Anderson (England) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
63' Declan Rice (England) whips in the resulting free kick but one of the defenders heads the ball to safety.
63' Thomas Partey (Ghana) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Said Martinez blows his whistle for a foul. England will take a free kick.
62' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Elliot Anderson (England) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
62' Declan Rice (England) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
61' Elliot Anderson (England) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one.
60' Inaki Williams (Ghana) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
60' Poor challenge! Inaki Williams (Ghana) is penalised for tripping and Said Martinez blows his whistle. England are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
58' Anthony Gordon (England) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot goalwards, but Benjamin Asare gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
57' Noni Madueke (England) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
53' The corner by Jordan Ayew (Ghana) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
52' Noni Madueke (England) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
50' Marvin Senaya (Ghana) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
47' Said Martinez blows his whistle after Marvin Senaya (Ghana) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Declan Rice (England) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
45+3' Harry Kane (England) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. It will be a corner kick for England.
45+1' The corner from Declan Rice (England) is hurriedly cleared.
45+1' Jude Bellingham (England) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. England force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
44' Jordan Ayew (Ghana) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

43' Antoine Semenyo (Ghana) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee signals a corner kick to Ghana.
41' Said Martinez shows a yellow card to Declan Rice (England) for his blatant foul.
41' Jude Bellingham (England) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
40' 84:16 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
37' Declan Rice (England) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
35' Anthony Gordon (England) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
33' Jude Bellingham (England) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
31' Ezri Konsa (England) tackles a bit over-zealously and Said Martinez blows for a foul.
26' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
23' Reece James (England) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on. Jordan Ayew (Ghana) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
21' Jordan Ayew (Ghana) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
21' Reece James (England) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
20' Reece James (England) sends a cross into the box, but Benjamin Asare comes off his line to gather the ball.
18' The foul by Inaki Williams (Ghana) was seen by Said Martinez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
17' Declan Rice (England) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
16' Declan Rice (England) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The referee blows his whistle, England are awarded a corner kick.
16' Elliot Anderson (England) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
14' Declan Rice (England) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
13' Marvin Senaya (Ghana) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Said Martinez signals. England have a free kick.
12' Reece James (England) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
10' Harry Kane (England) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Jude Bellingham, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
6' Declan Rice (England) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
6' Said Martinez blows his whistle after Kwasi Sibo (Ghana) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. England are awarded a free kick.
5' The linesman signals that Inaki Williams (Ghana) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
3' England are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
